name: F-78 blaster rifle
description: The F-78 blaster rifle, also called Mimbanese blaster, was a blaster rifle produced by BlasTech Industries worth 1,200 credits. A F-78 blaster rifle, modified with a vibrobayonet, was utilized by Iasento of the Mimbanese Liberation Army. Cloud-Rider member Waydurk carried a Mimbanese blaster.
